# Dually Insurance

Dually Insurance (duallyinsurance.com) is a licensed insurance agency specializing in dually truck insurance — commercial auto, physical damage, cargo, non-trucking liability, tools & equipment, and GAP coverage for F-350, Ram 3500, and Silverado 3500 owners across all 50 states.

## What We Do

We write insurance for dually truck owners:
- Contractors who haul equipment to jobsites
- Ranchers and livestock haulers
- Owner-operators under motor carrier authority
- Working truck owners who need commercial auto instead of personal auto

## Specialty Coverage

- Agreed value physical damage (not ACV)
- Non-trucking liability for owner-operators
- Livestock and equipment cargo
- GAP coverage for financed dually trucks
- Commercial umbrella
